headwords: chim có tổ, người có tông

flags.why: The example defines the animal instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Chúng tôi thấy một con cheo cheo chạy vào rừng. = We saw a mouse deer run into the forest.

flags.why: In Vietnamese geography, chi lưu carries water away from the main river, whereas a tributary feeds it ([school geography material](https://filethcs.hcm.edu.vn/data/doc/2025/thcsleanhxuanq11/2025_4/9/de-cuong-hk2_94202519.pdf)).
flags.fix: distributary; river branch flowing away from the main river

flags.why: Chia li means parting or separation, not an adjective meaning sad or tragic.
Chim ngói denotes turtle doves, while the spotted dove is chim cu gáy or cu cườm ([discussion distinguishing the birds](https://longhovinhlong.blogspot.com/2022/09/chuyen-van-gac-cu-cam-chau.html)).
The example explains what astrology does instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Ông ấy rất tin vào chiêm tinh thuật. = He strongly believes in astrology.
